questions.prompt: 어법상 가장 자연스러운 문장은?

options.text: Hardly did I arrived when the concert began.
Hardly have I arrive when the concert began.
Hardly had I arrived when the concert began.
Hardly I had arrived when the concert began.

hints: 부정어(Hardly)가 문두에 올 때의 도치 구조에 유의하세요.
Hardly + had + 주어 + p.p. + when ~ 구문입니다.
questions.explanation: 부정어 도치 구문으로 'Hardly had I arrived when ~' 형태가 정확합니다.
